rule:
fg22: grouped archive fsyncs (FG) vs main. Beads br-9ott5 (reservations fail under swarm load), br-kp1in.13 (WBQ drain cannot
keep up), br-qbhs0 (fsync cost per message). Written 2026-10-21 ~16:55Z by CopperGoose, while the cand build runs and before
any fg22 run. It gets a FROZEN line with the cand sha256 before its first run.

DISCLOSED CONTEXT. Everything below was seen before this rule.
- draindiag4 (one P2 run of the base binary below, ancestor /proc sampler, no ptrace; reservation errors 2410/2633, like rg21
  base): the wbq-drain thread spent 76% of its samples in fdatasync (inbox 28%, queued reservation artifacts 19%, canonical
  15%, outbox 14%), 12% on CPU, 12% in futex. At swarm end: wbq enqueued 14234, drained 7328, depth 6650,
  archive_message_gap 4338, wbq latency p50 134 s; completion 358 s, so the drain rate was ~20.5 ops/s against ~40 enqueued/s.
- Microbench (fsync_group_bench.py, this host's ext4, idle): 7 new 1 KB files synced one after another 64.3 ms; synced
  concurrently 20.7 ms; 3 files 27.4 vs 20.0 ms; 4 files 36.5 vs 20.1 ms. A mechanism check, not a whole-job number.
- rg21 base P2 runs: 92-95% of message-reconciler visits deferred on a busy fence (312/4518, 359/4679, 244/4365 verified).
  Seen while validating the evidence builder (same base binary, same server env as this rule): rg21 P2 drain rate base
  18.06 ops/s pooled (runs 18.00, 17.84, 18.36; completion 517, 531, 483 s; mean end gap 3004); rg21 cand (L2) 16.61 ops/s.
  draindiag4 ran without the batch_write log env and completed in 358 s.
- br-9sxrn history: staging bundle files outside the fence with parallel fsyncs (stagepar) removed fence contention but lost
  on closed-loop send-latency guards (10-11, 10-12) and, with L2+L3 (ab18), on P2 completion 1.12x and soak convergence. FG
  keeps the fence where it is; it only makes the syncs inside it concurrent.

LEVER (fg_v2.patch, storage lib.rs only; current-main diff hash 4d5f959c1cb4). fg_v1 (9d02efe211a6) was superseded before
any build finished or any run: it held a whole batch's rendered copies in memory; v2 stages incrementally.
- StagedArchiveWrites::add writes a temp file and defers its fdatasync to the current group; a group of 16 is synced
  concurrently (scoped threads; a failed spawn syncs inline); publish() syncs whatever is pending before renaming anything.
  Every file is still synced before its rename. stage() = add each + sync.
- The WBQ batch writer (write_message_batch_bundle) prepares each entry (render + canonical-id collision check), stages its
  canonical/outbox/inbox files into one StagedArchiveWrites, then publishes all in entry order and appends thread digests.
  A failure before publication now leaves no entry written (previously earlier entries stayed). write_message_bundle (single)
  groups its own files the same way. Fence and project-lock placement are unchanged.

ARMS (portable release, same host, host lock):
- base = build36/ab18b_base/am, sha256 3d35263d06e664f345572b9175c7102d445ba6e87b0ccf11a1ca491f5401e254 (2b5d14d7 + br-tsqvm),
  re-run live;
- cand = build36/fg22v2b_cand/am, built from rc1021f = 2b5d14d7 + the same br-tsqvm diff (af51a3426ded) + fg_v2.patch. Its build
  log must show diff=a13f6ac77e92. The sha256 is recorded at freeze.

RUNS: P2 (60 agents, period 2 s, 300 s of work): base cand cand base. P6: cand base base cand. Then the release smoke in both
orders (cand_vs_base, base_vs_cand) from rc1020f, as rg21. Validity as rg21: start when the 1-min load < 8; a run overlapping a
foreign >400% CPU process is invalid and re-queued; 6 h deadline. Disk guard: before every run, if / has < 8 GB free, stop;
the remaining runs are recorded as not run (never as failed), and a verdict missing primary data is INCONCLUSIVE.

PRIMARY (must hold):
- M1 (drain capacity at saturation): P2 drain rate = health queues.wbq.drained_total / completion_s per run.
  Pooled (sum drained / sum completion) cand >= 1.3x base, AND every valid cand P2 run's rate > every valid base P2 run's rate.

GUARDS (any failure = LOSS):
- G1 equal work: P2 completion median cand <= 1.05x base; smoke swarm acked sends cand >= 0.95x base in each order.
- G2 errors and safety:
  - non-reservation paced tool errors cand <= base + 5 (P2 and P6 pooled);
  - file_reservation_paths errors cand <= 1.02x base at P2 and at P6 (pooled);
  - smoke tool errors cand <= base + 5 in each order; cand crash phase PASS in each order; integrity_check ok;
  - no canonical-id collision errors in any cand log; smoke dispatch zombies cand == 0 or <= base's, in each order.
- G3 below saturation: P6 send p99 cand <= 1.2x base; every P6 completion <= 330 s; P6 mean archive_message_gap cand <= base + 50.
- G4 convergence: P2 mean archive_message_gap at swarm end cand <= base; the smoke soak "archive converges after load stops"
  must not pass for base and fail for cand in either order; post-swarm un-archived cand <= base + 2% of cand's acked sends.
- C, on current main + fg_v2.patch (rc1021e), all of:
  - storage lib nextest --no-fail-fast (only br-3ukrb's and br-u5biy's tests may fail, and only as on base);
  - storage + tools clippy -D warnings; workspace --lib --bins check; tools it; conformance;
  - planted negative: write_message_batch_bundle_publishes_nothing_when_a_later_file_cannot_be_staged FAILS on the old
    one-entry-at-a-time writer (base code + that test only).

REPORTED, not gated: P2 file_reservation_paths error rate per arm (the br-9ott5 probe); wbq depth and latency p50/p99 at swarm
end; reconciler verified/deferred counters; reservation p50/p99; send p50/p90 (closed-loop caveat).

DECISION:
- WIN only if M1, G1-G4 and C hold. A WIN lands fg_v2.patch (storage lib.rs; mine) with this rule and the evidence cited.
  br-9ott5, br-kp1in.13 and br-qbhs0 stay open unless their own probes pass.
- LOSS: one line on br-9ott5, br-kp1in.13 and br-qbhs0; the patch goes beside the receipt; nothing lands.

- The first attempt (OUT fg22) ran only P1 (p2 base, 21:21-21:28Z). / reached 0 bytes during it (67 'No space left' in its
  server log; P1 exit=120); the pre-run disk guard then stopped the series. P1 is INVALID (environment); no cand run happened.
  fg22 is kept as is and not pooled.
- The rerun uses OUT fg22b, the same arms, order, runs, rule and builder. Added validity rule, symmetric for both arms: a 15 s

DETERMINED 2026-10-21T22:16:52Z: G1 FAILS after all 4 fg22b P2 runs, all valid (foreign_samples=0, / >= 27 GB free).
- P2 completion: base 387.9, 360.9 s; cand 411.3, 386.3 s. Rule statistic (pct .5 of 2 = the larger): cand 411.26 vs base 387.91 =
  1.060x > 1.05x (means 398.8 vs 374.4 = 1.065x). VERDICT: LOSS. Nothing lands.
- Primary M1 PASSES (reported because the guard decides): pooled drain rate cand 30.295 vs base 21.354 ops/s = 1.42x; runs cand
  29.04, 31.63 > base 20.86, 21.88. G4 P2 gap passes: mean archive gap at swarm end cand 39 vs base 4056. P2 reservation errors
  918 vs 922 per 1000 (unchanged).
- The P6 runs (P5-P8) continue for reported data; the smoke will be stopped before it starts (its guards cannot change a LOSS).
NOTE 2026-10-21T22:23:37Z: changed my mind on stopping before the smoke. It runs for REPORTED data only (crash-phase and soak-convergence evidence for the owner's tradeoff decision); the verdict stays LOSS whatever it shows.

OWNER DECISION 2026-10-21T23:01:21Z: the user, asked (AskUserQuestion) after the LOSS was determined, chose "Land fg22 by your decision"
(option text: "You accept the tradeoff (+6% closed-loop completion at saturation for a current archive and much better P6 tails). I
finish the C gate (tools clippy, tools it, conformance), land fg_v2 citing your decision + the receipt, then pre-register FG+L2 for
reservations."). The measured verdict stays LOSS on G1; fg_v2 lands by owner decision, not as a WIN, after the C gate passes on
current main + fg_v2.
